text:
morgan: Midday rollout — who is taking the 11:30 slot? Quiet cutover (small proxy config + feature flag). Need a smoke owner and rollback plan. ping @sasha @liam

sasha: I can own smoke checks. What services are in scope?

liam: Are we doing any DB changes? I thought migrations were done last week.

anya: No DB migrations this time. Just toggle `feature_new_routing` and update proxy backend weight. Safe path but still want quick smoke. I can own rollback steps.

morgan: Perfect. Can you paste the rollback commands and the runbook link? I'll post to the console so the oncall sees it.

sasha: Smoke steps (short):
```bash
# health checks
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq .
# quick endpoint sanity
curl -fsS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.prod/v1/encode?text=smoketest
# run smoke script (ci runner available on infra-ops)
./scripts/smoke-check.sh --target canary
```
Will run the above at +2 and +10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: DPL-4821. Canary window scheduled 11:30–11:45. Auto-alert on 3xx/5xx surge. (owner: sasha)

liam: I'll monitor cpu/mem and latency dashboards for first 15m and stand by for rollback. :eyes:

anya: Rollback plan (short):
1) disable feature flag `feature_new_routing` via admin console
2) revert proxy weight to previous values (`proxy weight backend-a=80 backend-b=20`)
3) redeploy previous image tag `release-2026-03-17` if traffic anomalies persist
4) notify @oncall and open incident if errors > threshold

morgan: Thanks. I'll update the release train board and ping product. Can we agree: start 11:30, quick smoke checks +10m, decision at +15m to continue/rollback?

sasha: Yep. If smoke clear at +10, proceed with full rollout. If not, rollback immediately. :thumbsup: 

liam: ACK. I'll be in the channel at 11:25 for the kickoff.

anya: I'll post the exact revert commands to the runbook now: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quiet-cutover

morgan: All set. See you at 11:30. Thanks everyone.
